description: Starts a one-off payment for the full report and ready-to-send replies (A$29 in Australia, US$19 in the US, tax included, no subscription). Returns a secure Stripe checkout link: give it to the user to open and pay themselves (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card). Never ask for card details. After they pay, call get_report to fetch the full report. Only offer it when the user wants the full report.
